sentences.text: Annette Badland -LRB- born 26 August 1949 -RRB- is an English actress known for a wide range of roles on TV , radio and film .

She has played Margaret Blaine in the BBC science fiction series Doctor Who , Doomsday Dora in The Sparticle Mystery , Birdie Henshall in the drama series Cutting It , Mavis in season 6 of Skins , Ursula Crowe in children 's science fiction/fantasy series Wizards vs Aliens , and Babe Smith in soap opera EastEnders .
